briefdescription.para: Return true if we can prove that the value we're analyzing is fully available in the specified block.

detaileddescription.para: As we go, keep track of which blocks we know are fully alive in FullyAvailableBlocks. This map is actually a tri-state map with the following values: 0) we know the block is not fully available. 1) we know the block is fully available. 2) we do not know whether the block is fully available or not, but we are currently speculating that it will be.
